review_evidence: README identifies a Lean tactic library for simplifying arithmetic equalities over ENNReal, with examples proving probability-style equalities by transporting to real arithmetic.

The primary corpus includes the tactic/properties implementation and an extensive ENNRealTest suite covering arithmetic, coercions, operations, edge cases, stress cases, and benchmarks; these test modules are checked formal goals documenting tactic semantics and supported cases.
FILTER-011/FILTER-014 do not authorize deleting tests or benchmarks that carry useful formal statements, and no content-lossless selector was established.
summary: Retain ENNReal arithmetic tactics, properties, and their formal regression/benchmark goals.
